# Seeded from the Lane D post-WP8 2x2 sweep (tt-quietbox-0, 2026-08-16, tt-metal 55ce75be,
# sfpu_device_baseline_v1.tsv is the immutable p100a-era migration source and is deliberately untouched.
# COMPILER PROVENANCE (D6): a g++ DRIVER sha256 alone is AMBIGUOUS as a per-row compiler
# identity — across cc1plus-only rebuilds the driver is byte-identical (the 4633999c170e1a89…
# era proved it; note the converse fails too: a full sfpi rebuild changes the driver, as the
# current pin's rebuild did, 4633999c… → 4f7ff8bf…). The compiler_sha column records the
# compiler proper (cc1plus binary sha256) where known: the Lane D/E rows were archived with
# legacy__ckernel_sfpu_reduce_custom rows were measured with the sfpi-gcc bb56f1d7797 gate-fix
# gatefix-evidence-20260816/SHA256SUMS). The scheduled sweeps pin cc1plus directly via the
# PIN LINEAGE (authoritative narrative + values live in sweep_2x2.conf; this header must agree):
#   1. 33221397ebb2… — STALE first candidate (same driver sha 4633999c… but built from gcc
#      cd0af49be5c BEFORE the submodule advanced to bb56f1d7797, stamp no-op make); the pinpair
#      gate CAUGHT it on device, reproducing the pre-recalibration 855.5-vs-839 regression pair
#   2. e302718c2532700b… — verified stage2 rebuild from the bb56f1d7797 submodule; generated
#      Reduce-SDPA pack .text byte-identical to the gate-fix hybrid build
#      bb56f1d7797 + P0 all-lanes-enable (6294a1ba3ae) + smag testsuite, built at sfpi d82fb3b
#      (which also carries the 1-slot BH smag_to_int SFPCAST lowering, Lane N).
# The Lane J/K rows below (unarymaxmin-*/addint/subint) and Lane M's TopK correctness evidence
# were measured with the STALE cd0af49-era cc1plus 33221397ebb2…: recorded honestly per cell.
# Their promised re-measure happened under pin 3 (afe05a86…), NOT the once-promised e302718c…
# (superseded before the sweep ran): nightly-20260816b re-measured addint/subint to -34.82/-34.83%
# vs hand (WIN — Lane N's smag lowering; convert-smag-evidence-20260816) and flagged
# unarymaxmin-max/min causal WIN→LOSS FLIP RED (-1.52% → +0.51%, sem_on 23.84 → 24.33/tile) —
# owner triage pending (pin investigation vs reviewed baseline update); the cells below remain
# the reviewed record until that decision.
# CROSS-CHIP COMPARABILITY (D5): p150 cells are internally-valid same-source 2x2 pairs, but they
# are NOT same-source with the p100a records: 65d2c873/4ff5c848 changed the measured Min/Max
# kernel's .text for BOTH impls (verified by recompilation), and the chip class changed — every
# "p100a … reproduced" annotation below is a RATIO-LEVEL REPRODUCTION ONLY across a changed
# kernel and chip, never a same-source identity claim.
# expected_class (D4): the op's class-aware acceptance expectation (win/parity/loss/refusal).
# report() gates any transition away from win as RED (including win→byte-identical-refusal) and
# Selector convention for sweep rows: <op>:<cell> with cells sem_off/sem_on/hand_off/hand_on,
# rows keep their native selectors and absolute REDUCE_SDPA_BODY mean(PACK_ISOLATE) cycles.
# Baseline updates are a REVIEWED MANUAL step: nightly/weekly sweeps only report drift.
